name: io.github.duriantaco/skylos
description: Checks AI-agent code across languages: fake packages, removed auth, secrets, security, dead code.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server (the skylos command alone is the CLI).

environmentVariables.description: Skylos API key. Required for every MCP tool except `analyze` (which works without a key, 5 calls/day). The local CLI (`skylos verify`, hooks) needs no key.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLOS_API_KEY
